name: omnisign/docuseal
description: Omnisign DocuSeal: documents signed on a DocuSeal instance of one's own (open source, AGPL) or DocuSeal's cloud - a submission from a template, or from a PDF where the edition allows it, its submitters, embedded signing, reminders, the signed documents and the audit log, webhooks with their X-Docuseal-Signature checked; nothing leaves for a third party when self-hosted.
